webhooksEnabled.description: Enable or disable webhook delivery for all accounts

webhooks.description: Target URL that will receive webhook notifications via POST requests

webhookEvents.description: List of event types that will trigger webhook notifications
webhookEvents.title: WebhookEvents

webhooksCustomHeaders.description: Additional HTTP headers to include with webhook requests for authentication or tracking. The global list is sent to the global webhook URL only, an account-level list accompanies that account's deliveries
webhooksCustomHeaders.title: WebhooksCustomHeaders

notifyHeaders.description: Email headers to include in webhook payloads for additional context
notifyHeaders.title: NotifyHeaders

serviceUrl.description: Base URL of this EmailEngine instance (used for generating public URLs, path component is ignored)

notificationBaseUrl.description: Public callback URL for external OAuth providers. Falls back to serviceUrl if not set

trackClicks.description: Rewrite links in outgoing HTML emails to track click-through rates

trackOpens.description: Insert a tracking pixel in outgoing HTML emails to detect when messages are opened

imapIndexer.description: How much of a mailbox EmailEngine tracks on each sync

enumDescriptions.full: Track every change, including deletions. Slower but complete
enumDescriptions.fast: Detect new messages only. Cheaper, but deletions and flag changes are missed

x-meta.usage: Leave this unset to follow the instance-wide setting, and only override it for accounts whose mailboxes behave differently from the rest of your fleet. A very large mailbox that nothing else writes to is the usual reason.

imapIndexer.title: ImapIndexer

resolveGmailCategories.description: Automatically detect and categorize Gmail tabs (Primary, Social, Promotions, etc.) for IMAP connections

ignoreMailCertErrors.description: Allow connections to mail servers with self-signed or invalid TLS certificates (not recommended for production)

generateEmailSummary.description: Generate AI-powered summaries for incoming emails using OpenAI

openAiAPIKey.description: Your OpenAI API key for AI features

openAiModel.description: Model name for AI processing. Empty means the built-in default, gpt-6-luna

openAiAPIUrl.description: Base URL for the OpenAI API

x-meta.usage: Set this only for an OpenAI-compatible service that is not OpenAI itself, and include whatever path prefix that service mounts its API under. For Azure OpenAI that means `https://<your-resource>.openai.azure.com/openai/v1`, not the bare host.

openAiTemperature.description: Controls randomness in AI responses (0 = deterministic, 2 = very creative). Not sent to a reasoning model while it reasons

openAiTopP.description: Nucleus sampling parameter for AI text generation (0-1, lower = more focused). Not sent to a reasoning model while it reasons

openAiReasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort for reasoning models such as GPT-5 and later. Empty sends "low" to those models and nothing to others. A value the model refuses is dropped
openAiReasoningEffort.title: OpenAiReasoningEffort

openAiMaxTokens.description: Token budget for the prompt sent to the model, the instructions and the email together. The email text is cut to fit. Defaults to 30000

openAiPrompt.description: Instructions for the AI, sent as the system message ahead of the email. They say which JSON properties to return. Empty means the built-in instructions
openAiPrompt.example: Return a JSON object with the property "language", the ISO 639-1 code of the language the email is written in.

inboxNewOnly.description: Trigger "messageNew" webhooks only for messages arriving in the Inbox folder

serviceSecret.description: HMAC secret for signing API requests and validating webhooks

authServer.description: External authentication service URL for retrieving mailbox credentials dynamically

tokenAuditLog.description: Record which requests each access token makes, readable at GET /v1/tokens/{token}/log. Disabled by default, and entries only exist from the point it is enabled

proxyEnabled.description: Route all outbound connections through a proxy server: IMAP and SMTP sessions as well as HTTP/HTTPS requests (Gmail API, Microsoft Graph, OAuth2 token exchange, webhooks, license validation) unless a dedicated HTTP proxy is configured

proxyUrl.description: Proxy server URL for outbound connections

httpProxyEnabled.description: Route outbound HTTP/HTTPS requests (webhooks, OAuth2 token exchange, Gmail API and Microsoft Graph calls, license validation) through a dedicated proxy instead of the global proxy

httpProxyUrl.description: Dedicated proxy URL for outbound HTTP/HTTPS requests. When not set, HTTP/HTTPS requests use the global proxy

smtpEhloName.description: Hostname to use in SMTP EHLO/HELO commands (defaults to system hostname)

notifyText.description: Include plain text message content in webhook payloads

notifyWebSafeHtml.description: Sanitize HTML content to remove potentially dangerous elements before including in webhooks, and fold quoted thread history into a collapsed block

notifyTextSize.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of text content to include in webhook payloads

notifyAttachments.description: Include attachment data in webhook payloads

notifyAttachmentSize.description: Maximum size (in bytes) per attachment to include in webhook payloads

notifyCalendarEvents.description: Include parsed calendar event data in webhook payloads

mcpEnabled.description: Enable the MCP (Model Context Protocol) endpoint at /mcp, which lets AI agents work with the connected email accounts using access tokens. Disabled by default

mcpOAuthEnabled.description: Enable the built-in OAuth2 authorization server for the MCP endpoint, used by MCP clients that cannot be configured with a static access token. Requires mcpEnabled and a configured serviceUrl. Disabled by default

all.description: Enable detailed logging for all email accounts

maxLogLines.description: Maximum number of log entries to retain per account

sentryEnabled.description: Send unhandled error reports to a Sentry server. Applied at runtime, no restart needed. Ignored when the SENTRY_DSN environment variable is set

sentryDsn.description: Sentry DSN to send error reports to. If empty, reports go to the Sentry instance run by the EmailEngine developers

imapStrategy.description: IP address selection strategy for mailbox access when multiple local addresses are available: IMAP sessions, Gmail API and MS Graph requests, and the OAuth2 token requests of every account. The key keeps its historical name

enumDescriptions.default: Let the operating system pick the source address
enumDescriptions.dedicated: Reuse the same local address for an account, so the remote server sees a stable IP
enumDescriptions.random: Pick a random local address for every connection

imapStrategy.title: ImapStrategy

smtpStrategy.description: IP address selection strategy for sending over SMTP when multiple local addresses are available

enumDescriptions.default: Let the operating system pick the source address
enumDescriptions.dedicated: Reuse the same local address for an account, so the remote server sees a stable IP
enumDescriptions.random: Pick a random local address for every connection

smtpStrategy.title: SmtpStrategy

localAddresses.description: List of local IP addresses to use for outbound connections (requires appropriate network configuration)
localAddresses.title: LocalAddresses

smtpServerEnabled.description: Enable the built-in SMTP server for receiving emails

smtpServerPort.description: Port number for the built-in SMTP server

smtpServerHost.description: IP address to bind the SMTP server to (empty = all interfaces)

smtpServerProxy.description: Enable PROXY protocol support for the SMTP server. The PROXY header is accepted from any peer, so the port must only be reachable through the proxy

smtpServerAuthEnabled.description: Require SMTP authentication for incoming connections

smtpServerPassword.description: Password for SMTP authentication (null = disable authentication)

smtpServerTLSEnabled.description: Serve the SMTP submission server over implicit TLS. STARTTLS is never offered

tlsProvisioning.description: Where the TLS certificate for the built-in listeners comes from: "acme" orders one from Let's Encrypt, "manual" uses the certificate uploaded through the admin UI, "self-signed" stops trying to get a real one
tlsProvisioning.title: TlsProvisioning

tlsHostnames.description: Additional hostnames to hold certificates for, beyond the Service URL hostname. Each one is ordered separately and served over SNI, so a mail client connecting to smtp.example.com is offered a certificate for that name
tlsHostnames.title: TlsHostnames

apiTLSCertificate.description: The certificate the Admin UI and API presents by default (to a client that names no host, and for every name the certificate covers). "auto" lets EmailEngine decide: the material from EENGINE_API_TLS_* when it is set, otherwise the certificate for the Service URL hostname. Otherwise an id from the TLS Certificates page: "manual", "self-signed", "acme:<hostname>", or "env:api" / "env:smtp" / "env:imapProxy". A name the default does not cover is still served its own certificate

smtpServerTLSCertificate.description: The certificate the SMTP server presents by default (to a client that names no host, and for every name the certificate covers). "auto" lets EmailEngine decide: the material from EENGINE_SMTP_TLS_* when it is set, otherwise the certificate for the Service URL hostname. Otherwise an id from the TLS Certificates page: "manual", "self-signed", "acme:<hostname>", or "env:api" / "env:smtp" / "env:imapProxy". A name the default does not cover is still served its own certificate

imapProxyServerTLSCertificate.description: The certificate the IMAP proxy presents by default (to a client that names no host, and for every name the certificate covers). "auto" lets EmailEngine decide: the material from EENGINE_IMAPPROXY_TLS_* when it is set, otherwise the certificate for the Service URL hostname. Otherwise an id from the TLS Certificates page: "manual", "self-signed", "acme:<hostname>", or "env:api" / "env:smtp" / "env:imapProxy". A name the default does not cover is still served its own certificate

imapProxyServerPort.description: Port number for the IMAP proxy server

imapProxyServerHost.description: IP address to bind the IMAP proxy to (empty = all interfaces)

imapProxyServerProxy.description: Enable PROXY protocol support for the IMAP proxy. The PROXY header is accepted from any peer, so the port must only be reachable through the proxy

imapProxyServerPassword.description: Password for IMAP proxy authentication (null = disable authentication)

imapProxyServerTLSEnabled.description: Enable TLS support for the IMAP proxy

queueKeep.description: Number of completed and failed queue entries to retain for debugging

deliveryAttempts.description: Maximum number of delivery attempts before marking a message as permanently failed

gmailSubscriptionTtl.description: Gmail Pub/Sub subscription inactivity expiration in days. Empty for Google default (31 days), 0 for no expiration.

templateHeader.description: Custom HTML to inject at the top of hosted pages (e.g., for branding)

templateHtmlHead.description: Custom HTML to inject into the <head> section of hosted pages (e.g., for analytics)

scriptEnv.description: JSON object containing environment variables available to pre-processing scripts

enableApiProxy.description: Trust X-Forwarded-* headers when behind a reverse proxy

locale.description: Default language/locale for the user interface
locale.title: SettingsLocale

timezone.description: Default timezone for date/time display (IANA timezone identifier)

pageBrandName.description: Brand name displayed in page titles

openAiPreProcessingFn.description: JavaScript function to filter emails before AI processing (return true to process, false to skip)

imapClientName.description: Client name advertised via IMAP ID extension

imapClientVersion.description: Client version advertised via IMAP ID extension

imapClientVendor.description: Vendor name advertised via IMAP ID extension

imapClientSupportUrl.description: Support URL advertised via IMAP ID extension

exportMaxGlobalConcurrent.description: Maximum concurrent exports system-wide across all accounts

gmailExportBatchSize.description: Number of parallel message fetch requests for Gmail export operations (default: 10, max: 50)

outlookExportBatchSize.description: Number of messages per batch request for Outlook export operations (default: 20, max: 20 - MS Graph API limit)

exportMaxMessages.description: Maximum number of messages per export (default: 500000)

exportMaxSize.description: Maximum export file size in bytes (default: 10GB)

exportMaxMessageSize.description: Maximum size of a single message included in an export, in bytes. Larger messages are skipped (default: 50MB)

exportMaxAge.description: How long a finished export is kept before it is deleted, in milliseconds (default: 24 hours)
